name: r026-arp-spoofing
description: R026 (ARNO_SIEM MITM playbook A32): pfSense reports a host claiming the gateway IP (arp motif B) — CRITICAL, isolate_endpoint CONFIRM must target the attacker's real IP 192.168.189.50, never the usurped gateway 192.168.189.2. A single MAC change on an unprotected IP must NOT fire (known NIC-swap false positive).

lines.raw: Nov 10 10:00:00 pfsense kernel: arp: 52:54:00:aa:bb:50 is using my IP address 192.168.189.2 on em1 from 192.168.189.50!
